model: EFieldPhysNet rw_neutral (SPICE-alpha, parity-correct, dipole 100 / alpha 0.1, forces 10, energy weight 0)
environment: ML/MM mechanical embedding: peptide = model (float64, CPU), solvent sphere (TIP3P / custom DCM, DMSO, Ar, Kr) + counter-ions = CHARMM36 via pyCHARMM; minimisation of all atoms; peptide Hessian = ML + finite-difference MM coupling
isotopes: D2O systems: every H on N or O replaced by D (amide I'); other solvents: H
conformers: tripeptides: PPII and beta starts; capped dipeptides: C7 and C5; weighting = equal (equal by default: the independently solvated minima have incomparable total energies)
frequency_scaling: none ('unscaled' files) and a uniform factor chosen to maximise the correlation with the digitised trace ('scaledX' files; reported per entry)
limitations: mechanical embedding: no solvent polarisation of the model's charges/dipoles; solvent enters through geometry and the MM coupling Hessian only
harmonic, 0 K minima; two conformers per system; no anharmonic or thermal broadening beyond the Lorentzian
VCD from the model's charges-only atomic axial tensors
charged peptides evaluated with the neutral-trained model (rw_neutral) plus explicit counter-ions in the MM region
notes: Each entry's 'files' hold the broadened, normalised prediction on the digitised trace's own grid (unscaled and at the correlation-optimal uniform frequency scale). Raw stick spectra per conformer (H and D isotopologues), minimised geometries and model charges/dipole/polarizability are in raw/. Experimental traces are the site's own digitised CSVs (independently normalised); only shapes, positions and signs are comparable.
